decisions.reason: As a low-complexity accessory that supports the core trailer business and after-sales offer, it is worth retaining even if it is a niche item.
A box car trailer series is a core product for a trailer manufacturer and its home-page visibility suggests it is commercially important.
A car transporter trailer fits the firm's transport-equipment specialization and broadens the range for professional and dealer customers.
A low-bed trailer series is closely aligned with the firm's main business and was prominent enough to be shown on the home page.
A high trailer cover series complements existing trailers, supports customization, and strengthens the firm's practical accessory offering.
Although it overlaps in category with another box trailer series, it appears to serve an important market segment and helps maintain a broad, dealer-friendly portfolio.
